summary: Trace allocation, copies, execution and reuse so buffers remain alive until asynchronous users finish.
outcomes: Explain pageable versus pinned staging and transfer costs.
Design a double-buffered pipeline with correct reuse boundaries.
sequence: Draw separate host and device buffers.
Trace synchronous transfer and the simplest lifetime.
Introduce pinned memory and asynchronous transfer conditions.
Add two buffers and event-protected reuse.
Measure transfer direction, size and batching tradeoffs.

visual.question: When may the producer safely overwrite this input?
visual.interaction: Step fill, copy, compute and reuse; flag premature overwrites.

practice.success: Tail chunks work; no buffer is reused early; end-to-end time includes transfers.
